title: Ultra-low concentration PVA-doped PMMA: an all-organic dielectric with markedly improved dielectric properties and energy storage performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7618-7627
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08529B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuhao Chen, Guang Liu, Yang Cui, Chen Chen, Bocheng Wang, Han Chen, Taiquan Wu, Lifang Shen, Shubin Yan
By incorporating a small amount of PVA into PMMA, the dielectric constant of the composite dielectric was significantly increased with only a slight rise in dielectric loss, ultimately yielding a desirable energy storage density.
